title: Homogeneous chart for the extended Rees zero fibre
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq R$ an ideal. Let $E=R[t,I/t]\subseteq R[t,t^{-1}]$ be the $R$-subalgebra generated by $t$ and $a/t$ for $a\in I$. Let $\operatorname{gr}_I R=\bigoplus_{n\geq0} I^n/I^{n+1}$ be the associated graded ring [lem-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring-structure]. There is a ring isomorphism $e:\operatorname{gr}_I R\simeq E/(t)$ such that $e([a]_n)=[a t^{-n}]$ for every $n\geq0$ and $a\in I^n$. No finiteness or regularity hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Local construction, x_i=t u_i, and the general associated-graded representative calculation, Stacks 0630, 0632 and 01LX.

proof.text: Define [a] in degree n to map to a*t^(-n) modulo t. Ideal-product induction shows this Laurent monomial belongs to E. Changes by I^(n+1) are multiples of t. Quotient lifting and DirectSum.toSemiring therefore give a ring map.

source.place: Local construction, x_i=t u_i, and the general associated-graded representative calculation, Stacks 0630, 0632 and 01LX.

proof.text: Induct on membership in the algebra generated by t and a/t. Modulo t, t vanishes, constants come from degree zero, and a/t comes from degree one. Addition and multiplication preserve the image, proving surjectivity.

source.place: Local construction, x_i=t u_i, and the general associated-graded representative calculation, Stacks 0630, 0632 and 01LX.

proof.text: Choose ideal-power representatives for the finitely many nonzero graded components. If their Laurent sum is t times an element y of E, its coefficient at -n is the coefficient of y at -n-1. Algebra-adjoin induction proves that this coefficient lies in I^(n+1). Hence every graded component is zero, proving injectivity. Apply RingEquiv.ofBijective.

theorem rees_associatedGraded_chart :
    ∃ e : associatedGraded I ≃+*
      I.extendedReesAlgebra ⧸ Ideal.span {I.extendedReesAlgebraT},
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : (I ^ n : Ideal R)),
        ∃ ha : C a.val * T (-(n : ℤ)) ∈ I.extendedReesAlgebra,
          e (DirectSum.of (associatedGradedPiece I) n (Submodule.Quotient.mk a)) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ⟨C a.val * T (-(n : ℤ)), ha⟩
